## Change

Describe the concrete archive or website change and its scope.

## Provenance and validation

For archive files, identify the supplied package, source and hashes. Preserve
original names and bytes. For website changes, report checks and desktop/mobile
verification. Do not include passwords, credentials or routine machine logs.

## Delivery

Distinguish local checks, CI, merge, deployment and release/download verification.
Mention unfinished work and retained temporary resources only when applicable.
